# Danelfin

> > AI-powered stock picker and investment research platform that ranks stocks and ETFs across industries using proprietary AI Score technology.

Danelfin provides AI-driven stock analysis and portfolio optimization tools, helping investors identify the best-performing stocks and ETFs across diverse sectors including technology, healthcare, energy, and consumer goods. The platform leverages machine learning to generate predictive AI Scores for investment decision-making.

## Key Topics

- AI Score
- Stock Rankings
- ETF Analysis
- AI Stock Analysis
- Market Prediction
- Investment Research
- Stock Screening
- Portfolio Optimization
- Sector Analysis
- Technology Stocks
- Healthcare Stocks
- Energy Stocks
- Financial Services
- Consumer Goods
